summary: Implemented non-repo directory diagnosis and classification (ClassifyNonRepoFolder) in cloner/pulldiag.go with companion repository detection and upstream remote lookup, overhauled cmdautofix/fix.go to route repository fix requests to cmdfix.RunFix, equipped cmdfix/fix_cmd.go with non-repo smart clone and init remediation and full gitmap fix --all batch resolution, and added unit tests in cmdfix/fix_test.go.
verification: Targeted test 'go test -v ./cmdfix' in cli passed all 15 tests with 0 failures; 'go test ./cloner' and 'go test ./cmdautofix' passed with 0 failures.

acceptance.VG-SUB-01: PASS ClassifyNonRepoFolder accurately detects non-repo directories and validates missing .git roots.
acceptance.VG-SUB-02: PASS Companion repositories (repo-cache, repo-secrets, rc, rs, cache, storage) identified and upstream remote URLs resolved from Split-DB and gh CLI.
acceptance.VG-SUB-03: PASS Dual remediation options generated: Option 1 (gitmap clone) and Option 2 (git -C <path> init).
acceptance.VG-SUB-04: PASS cmdautofix/fix.go routes repository targets and --all / all requests seamlessly to cmdfix.RunFix.
acceptance.VG-SUB-05: PASS cmdfix.runFixDirect executes smart clone/init resolution on non-repo folders without errors.
acceptance.VG-SUB-06: PASS gitmap fix --all / fix all collects all pending pull items, live dirty repos, and companion repos and remediates in batch.
acceptance.VG-SUB-07: PASS Strict relative Git paths across all modified files, zero absolute paths, zero file:/// URIs.
